components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Booking / discovery-call CTA. Amber fill, inverts to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #ffd400); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #0a0a0a); font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-paper, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink-outline secondary action. Fills ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-paper, #fff); }

components.name: Editorial Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200, #dcdcda); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-gray-50, #f7f7f6); color: var(--color-gray-600, #4f4f4c); font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Live Status Badge
components.description: Healthy / live status. Amber fill with ink text and a pulsing dot.
components.css: .ds-status-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #ffd400); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #0a0a0a); font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-dot { width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1 } 50% { opacity: 0.45 } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-dot { animation: none } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting content panel; climbs to Raised on hover.
components.html:
Books straight into your dispatch

Confirmed bookings land in the system you already run.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200, #dcdcda); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,10,0.05); transition: box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(10,10,10,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-gray-600, #4f4f4c); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field; border shifts to ink with a focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200, #dcdcda); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font-family: Urbanist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-gray-500, #6f6f6b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); }

narrative.overview: BookMyCab is built for a controller glancing between calls at a busy private-hire desk, and for the owner who wants the marketing site to feel as serious as the trade. Both surfaces share one stance: ink on true-white paper, set in Urbanist (a clean geometric sans), with a single amber signal that means this is the thing that matters right now. On marketing surfaces Urbanist carries large confident headlines at heavy weight and the amber gets committed moments; inside the product the same palette goes Restrained, Urbanist carries headings and labels, JetBrains Mono carries the data, and the amber narrows to primary actions, the live state and the current selection. The machinery is never named to customers.
keyCharacteristics: True-white paper (#ffffff), near-black ink (#0a0a0a), one amber signal (#ffd400).
One geometric sans (Urbanist) carries everything, hierarchy by weight; JetBrains Mono for data only.
Restrained by default; the amber is rare, so it carries weight.
Lifted depth: surfaces sit on soft shadows, deepening with interactivity.
Operator-grade clarity over decoration, on both registers.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Dispatch Amber marks one idea per view: the primary action, or the live signal, or the single highlighted phrase. If two amber things compete, one is wrong. Its rarity is what makes it a signal.

rules.name: The Amber-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and icons on top of Dispatch Amber are always Ink (#0a0a0a), never white or grey.

rules.name: The True-White Rule
rules.body: The body background is #ffffff at chroma 0. Warmth is carried by the amber and the type, never by tinting the paper toward cream, sand or parchment.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for genuine technical data: fares, references, IDs, durations and aligned table figures. It is never used for prose, labels or headings. Everything that is not data is Urbanist.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All numeric data uses tabular-nums so columns and changing values stay aligned.

rules.name: The Earned-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth tracks interactivity. A static card rests at Resting; it climbs to Raised only on hover or selection. Decorative shadows on non-interactive elements are forbidden.

rules.name: The One Signature Rule
rules.body: The Signature shadow appears once per page, on the single most important object.

dos: Do keep the body background true white (#ffffff) at chroma 0; carry warmth through Dispatch Amber and Urbanist's heavier weights.
Do put Ink (#0a0a0a) text on every amber surface, never white.
Do hold Dispatch Amber to one idea per view; in product UI keep it to ~10% of the surface, for primary actions, the live state and the current selection only.
Do set all numbers in tabular-nums and cap prose at 65-75ch.
Do let Urbanist carry every heading, label and prose number; reserve JetBrains Mono for genuine data (fares, references, IDs, durations, table figures).
Do make depth earn its place: Resting at rest, Raised on hover, one Signature shadow per page.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback, and make reveals enhance an already-visible default.
Do say 'your automation' / 'BookMyCab Automation Engine'; never expose the engine's real name.
donts: Don't tint the background toward cream, sand, beige or parchment.
Don't ship a purple/blue gradient hero, the hero-metric template, or identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't use gradient text or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a coloured accent stripe.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section, or numbered 01/02/03 markers on sections that aren't a genuine sequence.
Don't use cab-trade kitsch (checkers, cartoon taxis, emoji cars, traffic lights) or the cold corporate-blue / Fira-Code look of the stale design-system MASTER doc.
Don't set prose, labels, buttons or headings in JetBrains Mono (it is for data only), and don't let white sit on amber.
Don't write marketing-buzzword copy or use em dashes; name what the product literally does.
